staged-artifacts.requirement: Both staged target binaries, metadata, sources, documentation, licenses, and hashes match the candidate.

staged-consumer.requirement: An external consumer resolves both staged modules and executes the selected target runtime and configuration.

numerical-parity.requirement: Frozen baseline comparisons pass with the approved metrics and limits on this lane.

physical-correctness.requirement: Independent physical checks pass or retain explicit failed dispositions on this lane.

unchanged-java-corpus.requirement: All applicable unchanged baseline Java tests execute on the JVM candidate.

java-source-compatibility.requirement: Unchanged Java consumers compile and run with the compatibility API and shared state.

duplicate-provider.requirement: The staged consumer rejects simultaneous dyn4j and dyn4k-core providers.

migration-journeys.requirement: The pinned unchanged sample collection compiles and completes each required observed journey.

performance-resource.requirement: Approved sustained timing, allocation, and memory probes pass on validated reference environments.

publication-contract.requirement: All target publications pass the staged artifact and checksum audit.

independent-review.requirement: Separate standards and spec reviews resolve actionable findings.
